headline: General Manager & Lead Developer | Full-Stack Web Development | Application Security
summary: Computer Science graduate and General Manager & Lead Developer at JZ Tech, combining hands-on software development with technical scoping, stakeholder communication and end-to-end website delivery. Delivered and maintain live websites for JZ Tech, JZ Supports & Maintenance and Golden Hour Pilates using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vite and Vercel. Practical experience includes accessible responsive interfaces, booking-platform integrations, browser testing, release workflows and secure full-stack applications, alongside postgraduate study in cybersecurity.

education.details: Major in Software Engineering and Cybersecurity
Cybersecurity specialization; relevant coursework/projects include software testing and analysis, machine learning/AI, secure systems, and applied security review work.

bullets.text: Designed and developed a full-stack AI-assisted resume tailoring platform that generates structured HTML and PDF outputs from job descriptions using Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs with dual-provider fallback logic.
Implemented strict no-fabrication validation logic and a structured JSON resume format with weighted bullet points and importance scores to enforce factual consistency across generated outputs.
Extended the platform into a multi-user SaaS with Supabase Auth, server-side Flask sessions, and a per-user generation dashboard tracking usage history.
Implemented monthly usage limits enforced server-side — blocking generation requests at 10/month per user without hitting the AI API, with usage tracked in Supabase with RLS-enforced data isolation.
Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD security pipeline with Bandit, Semgrep, Gitleaks, and pip-audit — scanning for vulnerabilities, secrets, and CVEs on every push to main.
Identified and resolved a medium severity Bandit finding (B104 interface binding vulnerability) surfaced by the pipeline, documenting the fix in the project README.
Deployed the application with VPN-only access (Tailscale) on a cloud VM to restrict public exposure and protect user data.
Maintained structured project documentation and validation checks so generated outputs stay consistent, traceable, and easy to review before use.
Built and maintained a professional portfolio website to present software engineering, cybersecurity, AI, and DevSecOps projects with clear project narratives, links, and technical positioning.
Implemented a responsive, polished front-end using modern JavaScript tooling and a reusable visual system to keep project showcases consistent across desktop and mobile.
Completed a website and local repository security review, then marked the project secured across public-facing and local scopes with Sentinel artefacts retained for audit/reference.

Expanded the portfolio into a central project evidence hub with security, AI, DevSecOps, and support case studies, including safe interactive demos and documented local-run paths where public hosting would be risky or unnecessary.
Built a conversion-focused React/TypeScript landing page for SaaS-focused penetration testing and security readiness services, positioning technical security testing for founders and product teams.
Created a practical outreach funnel with SaaS founder messaging, service positioning, and LinkedIn DM templates to turn security testing capability into a client acquisition workflow.
Completed and documented security review coverage for both the public-facing website and local repository, with Sentinel artefacts linked for evidence and follow-up tracking.
Documented review outcomes and follow-up items in a repeatable security review workflow, keeping evidence available for later audit and remediation tracking.
Built and launched a cybersecurity assessment platform aligned to the ACSC Essential Eight maturity model, deployed on Vercel with Supabase for data persistence.
Designed a 19-question structured assessment with automated scoring, category-level risk breakdowns, and CTI-backed findings.
Automated HTML report delivery using SendGrid transactional email and integrated Calendly booking to convert assessments into consultations.
Deployed a live marketing funnel with a landing page and LinkedIn launch assets to drive inbound leads.
Integrated a live web vulnerability scanner into the results page — triggered after the Essential Eight assessment, with findings stored in Supabase and included in the HTML email report.
Implemented an email gate for new users prior to scanning, with direct scan access for returning authenticated users.

Developed a full-stack incident management console with a React/TypeScript frontend and FastAPI/Python backend, containerised with Docker and preserved as a portfolio case study/local-run project after public Render hosting was archived.
Implemented structured incident lifecycle tracking with severity classification, status transitions, ownership, SLA breach indicators, and root-cause analysis capture.

Designed the console around support-team workflows including ticket ownership, severity triage, status updates, SLA indicators, and root-cause notes to make issue handling easier to track and escalate.
Built a full-stack GitHub Actions security pipeline covering Python (Bandit, pip-audit) and JavaScript (npm audit, Gitleaks) with a consolidated fail-gate enforcing zero HIGH findings before merge.

Discovered 8 CVEs in backend Python dependencies via pip-audit; replaced python-jose (no upstream fix path) with PyJWT and migrated the JWT authentication implementation to eliminate the vulnerability chain.
Resolved a high severity frontend vulnerability identified by npm audit by upgrading the Vite toolchain to v7 and associated plugin dependencies.

Pivoted the project presentation from an always-on hosted service to a safer portfolio simulation/case study, keeping the operational workflow visible while avoiding unnecessary public infrastructure exposure.
Built a full-stack web vulnerability scanner with 6 scanner modules covering security headers, SSL/TLS, sensitive path exposure, cookie flags, open redirects, and information disclosure.
Implemented concurrent URL scanning via ThreadPoolExecutor — each URL scanned in parallel with a shared requests.Session for efficiency, supporting single and batch scan modes.
Built a React/Tailwind dashboard with severity-coded findings (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO), collapsible per-URL sections, and client-side JSON report export.
Added a GitHub Actions CI/CD security pipeline with Bandit SAST, Gitleaks secrets detection, and pip-audit dependency scanning with fail-gate on HIGH findings.

Reworked the public presentation into a safe sample-results demo/case study instead of an unrestricted live scanner, with real arbitrary URL scanning deferred behind future auth, rate limits, and allowlist controls.
Built a full-stack security testing tool that probes LLMs for prompt injection, jailbreaking, system prompt extraction, data exfiltration, and role confusion attacks across 15 test cases.
Compared Llama 3.2 (local via Ollama) against Claude Haiku — Llama achieved 15/15 resistant while Haiku returned 3 FAIL and 5 PARTIAL, with HIGH severity prompt injection failures.
Built a React/Tailwind dashboard with per-category breakdowns, severity badges, expandable prompt/response rows, and JSON report export.
Designed an extensible JSON attack library so new test cases and categories can be added without modifying backend or frontend code.
Presented the tool through a safe interactive recorded-results demo in the portfolio, keeping real model/API execution protected for local or controlled environments.

Built an automated cybersecurity content pipeline that aggregates HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs from NVD, actively exploited vulnerabilities from CISA KEV, and AI security research from arXiv — then uses Claude Haiku to draft LinkedIn posts for review.

Implemented tone control (professional/conversational/technical) and a React/TypeScript dashboard for draft review and one-click clipboard copy, with portfolio presentation shifted to a safe interactive demo using sample threat-intel data.
Resolved 6 CVEs in dependencies (Flask, Flask-CORS, Requests) and a HIGH severity Bandit B201 finding (hardcoded Flask debug mode) surfaced by the CI/CD security pipeline.
Designed the workflow for scheduled Discord delivery through GitHub Actions/webhooks so generated cybersecurity briefings can be reviewed before posting publicly.
Benchmarked three small language models (Llama 3.2, Phi-3 Mini, Gemma 2) running entirely offline via Ollama on a CPU-only Ubuntu VM, with no GPU or cloud API dependency.
Designed a Python benchmarking script evaluating all 3 models across 4 task types (summarisation, JSON extraction, code generation, and multi-step reasoning) — 12 data points total.
Identified task-specific failure modes including two 120s timeouts that would not surface in quality-only evaluations, informing model selection recommendations by task type.
Documented speed vs quality tradeoffs: Gemma 2 fastest at 4.8 tok/s, Llama 3.2 most reliable (4/4 tasks), Phi-3 Mini best code quality but unreliable on structured output.
Added the benchmark as an interactive portfolio results explorer, making offline model tradeoffs easier to review without requiring a hosted backend or cloud inference.

projects.name: CSCI933 Machine Learning / Shakespeare RAG Coursework

bullets.text: Completed machine learning coursework comparing statistical regression models and neural network approaches on the Bike Sharing dataset, including data understanding, feature engineering, model evaluation, and report preparation.
Built and organized starter code for a Shakespeare small-language-model/RAG assignment, including chunking, retrieval, indexing, baseline generation, evaluation, and sample output workflows.

projects.name: CSCI926 Software Testing and Analysis Group Project

bullets.text: Completed a software testing and analysis group project covering verification and validation activities, test planning, reporting, and presentation of testing evidence for a real-world software project.
Studied and applied testing concepts including symbolic execution, test adequacy, functional testing, fuzzing, combinatorial testing, structural testing, and data-flow/control-flow models.
Built a cross-platform mobile application using React Native and TypeScript with a focus on privacy-conscious data handling for sensitive health-related user interactions.
Implemented Firebase integration for authentication, cloud data storage, and messaging workflows.
Added geolocation and media upload capabilities with structured in-app navigation.
Lead technical scoping, implementation planning and website delivery at JZ Tech, translating business and client requirements into maintainable releases.
Develop and maintain live websites for JZ Tech, JZ Supports & Maintenance and Golden Hour Pilates, covering responsive interfaces, service discovery, booking integrations and release quality.
Refined the JZ Tech website with a clearer service hierarchy, client-project showcase, mobile enquiry navigation and a two-step enquiry interface while preserving the existing backend.
Implemented resilient hero-video behaviour with user playback controls, mobile poster presentation, offscreen pausing and reduced-motion, data-saving, load-failure and no-JavaScript fallbacks.
Verified a JZ Tech release with 37 Chromium browser assertions across five viewport widths, alongside contact-schema tests, ESLint, TypeScript, production builds and 16 automated contrast checks.

Coordinated stakeholder review and approved releases across the three websites, preserving remote Git history, client-owned assets and existing integrations while documenting verification evidence and outstanding limitations.

experience.title: Freelance Web Developer & Digital Solutions Consultant

bullets.text: Delivered three production websites for Australian small businesses across web services, disability and property support, and boutique fitness, owning the lifecycle from discovery and content planning through development, launch and handoff.
Translated stakeholder goals, supplied brand guides and incomplete business information into clear requirements, site architecture, conversion journeys and maintainable implementation plans.

Designed and built responsive web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS and component-based design systems tailored to each client's technical and visual needs.
Created and applied reusable brand systems covering colour, typography, spacing, imagery, design tokens and component states, including a configurable HTML and JSON brand-guide generator.

Improved lead and booking journeys through clear value propositions, proof-first content, mobile-first navigation, prominent calls to action, class and service discovery, FAQs and direct third-party booking integrations.

Implemented WCAG-aligned patterns including semantic landmarks, keyboard navigation, skip links, visible focus states, accessible accordions, contrast validation, responsive layouts and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Established technical SEO foundations with page-specific metadata, canonical URLs, Open Graph data, robots directives, XML sitemaps, meaningful heading structures and local-business content pathways.
Introduced repeatable quality gates using ESLint, TypeScript type checking, production builds, automated contrast checks, browser screenshots and desktop and mobile interaction testing.
Automated build and source-control workflows with GitHub Actions, protected production work through branch-based experimentation and configured upstream synchronisation for client-owned repositories.
Deployed and handed over production sites through Vercel, configuring custom domains, HTTPS, production branches, GitHub application access and client-controlled repository and hosting ownership.

Diagnosed cross-platform production incidents involving stale Vercel commits, recreated GitHub repository identities, author-permission restrictions, DNS propagation, SSL redirects and Microsoft 365 mail records.
Integrated external platforms including Mindbody booking and timetable services, Google Maps and directions, Microsoft 365 email DNS, Relume Library MCP and client-owned GitHub and Vercel accounts.

Produced technical handoff documentation and structured project ownership so clients could control domains, repositories, deployments and future content updates without being locked into the developer's accounts.
Designed and developed the production website for JZ Tech, an Australian web studio, using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and a responsive conversion-focused layout.
Owned the end-to-end product workflow from business positioning and information architecture through visual exploration, implementation, browser QA, deployment preparation and client handoff.
Implemented a portable brand system using JSON, CSS and Tailwind design tokens, with an automated WCAG contrast gate included in the production build and GitHub Actions quality pipeline.

Developed a name-neutral brand foundation and reusable HTML brand-guide generator with configurable colours, typography, logo assets, JSON import and export, browser persistence and print-ready PDF output.
Structured the homepage around a clear value proposition, service offering, delivery process, proof, frequently asked questions and strong calls to action for Australian small-business clients.

Used Magic Patterns and AI-assisted image-to-video generation to explore multiple hero directions, then translated the selected concept into maintainable production code rather than shipping generated prototype code directly.

Built a cinematic hero experience with a web-optimised video, static mobile poster, muted desktop playback, data-saving behaviour and reduced-motion fallback while preserving headline readability and performance.
Implemented responsive navigation, keyboard-accessible interactions, visible focus states, semantic landmarks, reduced-motion support and verified colour contrast across desktop and mobile layouts.

Added production SEO foundations including metadata, Open Graph artwork, robots directives and XML sitemap generation, then prepared the GitHub and Vercel workflow for client-owned deployment and future updates.
Created a repeatable quality gate covering ESLint, TypeScript type checking, production builds and automated brand-contrast validation, with the checks enforced through GitHub Actions.
Used isolated Git branches and local preview environments to test major redesign and cinematic-media experiments without destabilising the production branch or live website.
Prepared a client-owned GitHub and Vercel operating model with repository transfer, production-branch configuration, upstream synchronisation and maintainable update workflows.
Diagnosed stale Vercel deployments caused by recreated GitHub repository IDs and commit-author membership restrictions, separating source-control issues from DNS and browser caching problems.

experience.title: Freelance Web Developer & Digital Solutions Consultant

bullets.text: Rebuilt and launched a seven-route service website for JZ Supports & Maintenance using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript and genuine Relume component sources adapted into an editable local codebase.

Used the authenticated Relume Library MCP to source genuine editable React marketing components, vendored the component code locally and adapted it to the project's brand, content and interaction requirements.
Integrated shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Relume Icons and Motion primitives into a cohesive component system while preserving full local ownership of the production source code.
Structured service journeys for NDIS supports, domestic assistance, indoor services and outdoor maintenance, with clear service boundaries and no unverified funding or eligibility claims.
Developed seven public routes for the homepage, about, contact and four service areas using reusable service, FAQ and navigation components, with consistent Domestic Assistance naming.

Researched and linked authoritative scheme information while adding clear disclaimers around NDIS and insurance eligibility, approvals and service scope to avoid unsupported commercial or funding claims.
Fixed reduced-motion hydration mismatches and initially hidden page content, keeping primary content visible without JavaScript and providing keyboard-operable navigation and accordions.

Built responsive navigation and photo-led service discovery, replacing disabled enquiry forms with clear contact-status guidance and preparation checklists while operational contact details remained unconfirmed.
Implemented a reusable visual system covering typography, spacing, colour tokens, image treatments, buttons, cards and interaction states across all seven routes.
Implemented canonical metadata, robots and sitemap generation, local image assets, automated lint, typecheck and production-build checks, and a client-owned GitHub and Vercel deployment workflow.
Added page-specific titles, descriptions and canonical URLs, Open Graph metadata, XML sitemap generation and robots directives for a consistent technical SEO foundation.
Optimised locally owned images with Next.js Image, responsive sizing, meaningful alternative text and priority loading where appropriate to improve performance and avoid external asset dependencies.

Validated all seven public pages with build, lint and TypeScript checks, responsive homepage checks across six widths, keyboard and no-JavaScript testing, and automated axe WCAG A/AA scans reporting zero violations on the tested pages.
Configured client-owned GitHub and Vercel deployment, custom domains and HTTPS, then identified a root-domain certificate mismatch while confirming the canonical www site remained healthy.
Reduced homepage length by approximately 18% at a 1440-pixel viewport through a tighter hero, clearer four-service navigation and more concise process content.

experience.title: Freelance Web Developer & Digital Solutions Consultant

bullets.text: Designed, developed and launched a responsive client website for Golden Hour Pilates using React and Vite, translating an existing visual identity into a conversion-focused digital experience.

Translated the client's supplied logo application guide into a production colour palette, typography hierarchy, logo treatment and reusable responsive components while preserving the established Golden Hour identity.

Built a complete single-page customer journey spanning hero messaging, studio proof, introductory offer, class discovery, timetable, first-visit guidance, frequently asked questions, location and contact information.
Created clear class, studio and booking journeys with strengthened calls to action, mobile-first navigation and direct pathways into the client's external booking platform.

Integrated the Momence timetable and booking journeys, including class and introductory-offer links, loading and recovery states, and studio-contact fallbacks; maintained the existing Brevo subscription form integration.

Implemented interactive React features including a mobile navigation drawer, active-section tracking, scroll progress, class finder, animated FAQ accordion, reveal transitions and a persistent mobile booking bar.

Added responsive Google Maps and directions integration, semantic telephone and email links, studio details and external booking links to connect the marketing site with the client's real operating systems.

Improved mobile navigation and timetable accessibility with shared overlay focus management, background inertness, Escape handling, focus restoration and removal of hidden booking controls from keyboard navigation.
Optimised locally supplied logo and studio assets into appropriate SVG, WebP and image formats, preserving brand quality while reducing reliance on external assets.

Validated a website release with 25 Chromium browser assertions across five viewport widths, covering Momence widget mounting, navigation, timetable keyboard behaviour, class and FAQ interactions, and simulated widget-load failure.
Managed the GitHub ownership handoff and Vercel deployment workflow, including custom-domain configuration, HTTPS validation and automated fork synchronisation for ongoing upstream updates.
Configured a reusable upstream-to-client fork synchronisation workflow so the client retained repository ownership while approved technical updates could continue through GitHub Actions.
Diagnosed stale production deployments caused by recreated repository IDs and commit-author permissions, and traced Microsoft 365 mail disruption to missing DNS records during the hosting cutover.

Verified Vercel origin health, redirects and certificate behaviour independently from public DNS, allowing hosting, propagation and local resolver issues to be isolated without unnecessary production changes.
Clarified introductory pricing and class-pack value with per-class comparisons, tighter mobile typography and fixed-header anchor offsets while preserving existing prices and purchase destinations.
Delivered project-based AI development and software updates, handling technical scoping, implementation, testing, and documentation across recurring engagements.
Built and iterated full-stack applications using Python, Flask or FastAPI, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, and database-backed workflows.
Integrated OpenAI, Anthropic, and local LLM tooling into structured generation, benchmarking, automation, and security-testing workflows.
Developed responsive React and TypeScript interfaces for dashboards, reporting, review workflows, and technical project demonstrations.
Developed Python API services and integrations for authentication, structured data processing, report generation, and third-party platform workflows.
Implemented secure development checks with GitHub Actions, Bandit, Semgrep, Gitleaks, pip-audit, and npm audit, then remediated identified application and dependency issues.
Containerised, deployed, and maintained applications using Docker, Nginx, Vercel, Supabase, and controlled remote-access tooling.
Tested and troubleshot software across Windows, WSL2, and Linux environments, documenting fixes, technical decisions, and handover notes.
Contributed to front-end and back-end feature development for a dynamic web platform.
Implemented responsive UI components and API-driven features to enhance usability and data interaction.
Collaborated with stakeholders to translate functional requirements into maintainable code.
Implemented custom front-end features for an eCommerce website with focus on clean layout and responsiveness.
Supported server-side functionality for product displays, transactional workflows, and content updates.
Enhanced mobile usability and cross-device consistency across the platform.
